typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		SETTLEMENT_METHOD as string,
		PAYMENT_STATUS as string,
		TRANSFER_ID as decimal(38,0),
		TRANSFER_TYPE as string,
		TRADE_ID as decimal(38,0),
		AMOUNT as double,
		VALUE_DATE as string,
		SETTLE_DATE as string,
		TRADE_DATE as string,
		TRADE_CCY as string,
		SETTLE_CCY as string,
		NETTED_TRANSFER as decimal(38,0),
		IS_PAYMENT as decimal(38,0)
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(LoadDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> AddLoadDate
OLEDBSource aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
AddLoadDate sink(input(
		LOAD_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		PAYMENT_STATUS as string,
		AMOUNT as integer,
		TRADE_CCY as string,
		TRANSFER_ID as string,
		TRADE_DATE as string,
		TRANSFER_TYPE as string,
		SETTLE_DATE as string,
		VALUE_DATE as string,
		TRADE_ID as string,
		SETTLE_CCY as string,
		SETTLEMENT_METHOD as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		LOAD_DATE = LoadDate,
		PAYMENT_STATUS,
		AMOUNT,
		TRADE_CCY,
		TRANSFER_ID,
		TRADE_DATE,
		TRANSFER_TYPE,
		SETTLE_DATE,
		VALUE_DATE,
		TRADE_ID,
		SETTLE_CCY,
		SETTLEMENT_METHOD),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
